CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY ------
For the Appellant : Mr. Mohit Prakash, Advocate Mr. Vishal Srivastava, Advocate For the Resp.-State : Mr. Sanat Kr. Jha, Addl.P.P. For the Resp. No.2 : Mr. Gaurav Priyadarshi, Advocate ------
Order No:-05 Dated:-30-03-2026 Heard the parties.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that this interlocutory application has been filed with the prayer to release the appellant on bail during the pendency of this appeal.

It is next submitted that the appellant has been convicted and sentenced vide Judgment of conviction dated 07.03.2025 and Order of sentence dated 17.03.2025 respectively, passed by the learned AJC- XV-cum-FTC (CAW),
Ranchi in connection with S.T. No.422 of 2018 arising out of Complaint Case No. 2046 of 2017 as under:-
Offence u/s Sentence Fine Default 376(1) of I.P.C. R.I. for seven years Rs.10,000/- S.I. for nine months 323 of I.P.C. R.I. for nine months Rs.500/- S.I. for fifteen days 506 of I.P.C. R.I. for nine months Rs.500/- S.I. for fifteen days
Learned counsel for the appellant further submits that it has also been ordered that all the sentences shall run concurrently.

It is then submitted that during the Irfan Ansari @ Md. Irfan Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand on 30 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32710041/
1 pendency of the trial, the appellant was granted anticipatory bail and he all along co-

entities.text: Irfan Ansari @ Md. Irfan Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: operated with the trial of the case.
It is then submitted that after his conviction on 07.03.2025, he has been in custody for over a year.
It is then submitted that the appellant has very good grounds to agitate in this appeal and unless he is admitted to bail, he will be highly prejudiced.
It is further submitted that there is no likelihood of this appeal being disposed of in near future.
It is lastly submitted that the appellants undertake to co-operate with the hearing of this appeal.
Hence, it is submitted that the appellants be enlarged on bail.
Learned counsel for the respondent No.2 opposes the prayer for bail of the appellant.

Considering the aforesaid facts of the case, the appellant, named above, is directed to be released on bail till disposal of this appeal, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned AJC-XV-cum-FTC (CAW), Ranchi in connection with S.T. No.422 of 2018 arising out of Complaint Case No. 2046 of 2017 with the condition that he will co-operate with the hearing of this appeal.
Accordingly, this Interlocutory Application is allowed.
(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.)
List this appeal under the heading 'Hearing' before the appropriate Bench.

(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) Dated:-30.03.2026 Saroj/
